item.title: Ohio State Holds Firm At No. 1 In AP And Coaches Polls After 48-10 Win Over UCLA
item.description: With two weeks remaining in the regular season, every team across college football is still looking up at Ohio State. The Buckeyes held strong at No. 1 in both the AP and USA Today Coaches Polls following their 48-10 drubbing over UCLA in primetime at Ohio Stadium. Indiana and Texas A&M — which survived an upset scare by South Carolina, erasing a 30-3 halftime deficit to hold off the Gamecocks — also maintained their standings at No. 2 and No. 3, respectively, in both polls. item.title: Ohio State a 33.5-Point Favorite in Final Regular-Season Home Game Against Rutgers
item.description: Another week, another lofty spread in favor of Ohio State. According to DraftKings, the Buckeyes opened as 31.5-point favorites against Rutgers ahead of their matchup at Ohio Stadium on Saturday. That spread has since risen to 33.5 points in the short time since it went live. Sitting at 10-0 on the season, Ohio State has also been quite impressive against the spread, boasting an 8-2 mark. item.title: Christoph Tilly's Game-Winning Heroics, Bruce Thornton's 24 Points Push Ohio State Past Notre Dame 64-63
item.description: Bruce Thornton's sheer will for victory has never been questioned. On Sunday, he put on another display. The Buckeyes' four-time captain and brightest star scored close, scored from midrange and scored deep to rack up 24 points. He played excellent perimeter defense against a 3-point-centric Notre Dame team. But it was Christoph Tilly who proved the hero in the end. item.title: Snap Counts: Gabe VanSickle Plays More Snaps Than Tegra Tshabola, Bo Jackson Plays Career-High 35 Snaps in Ohio State’s Win vs. UCLA
item.description: Numerous offensive players played their biggest roles of the season so far for Ohio State in its 10th game of the year against UCLA. Most notably, Gabe VanSickle played the most snaps among right guards against the Bruins as someone other than Tegra Tshabola played the most snaps at RG for the first time this season.
